desc: Ideation complete: split pattern into three literal fragments and plan occurrence-list/sweep optimization.
Implement a reusable linear-time occurrence finder for a literal fragment in s using KMP or Z-function, returning sorted start indices.
Split p into left, middle, and right fragments and handle empty fragments, including p == "**" returning 0 and missing required literals returning -1.
Precompute for each position the latest valid left start whose occurrence ends at or before that position, treating an empty left fragment as matching at the current position.
Precompute for each position the earliest valid right end whose occurrence starts at or after that position, treating an empty right fragment as matching at the current position.
Scan middle occurrences to combine best left start and right end, handling the empty-middle case by directly pairing left and right occurrences.
Track the global minimum span and return -1 if no valid triple exists.
Add and run tests covering all-empty patterns, empty prefix/middle/suffix, adjacent stars, overlapping literal parts, no match, and the provided examples.
